phase1.inputDescription: Simulated axes enter the same PlayerMotor.Update/StepFromInput/CharacterController.Move path as hardware; this is not a physical keyboard test.
phase1.collisionPolicy: exported original collider geometry reconstructed as static MeshColliders
phase1.visualPolicy: original mesh geometry, extracted primary colors and supported raw textures; reconstruction shaders, color-space interpretation not independently verified; original body/face and default-active attachments only; Standard player materials, no original Animator or game behaviours

phase2.collisionPolicy: exported original collider geometry reconstructed as static MeshColliders
phase2.visualPolicy: original mesh geometry, extracted primary colors and supported raw textures; reconstruction shaders, color-space interpretation not independently verified; original body/face and default-active attachments only; Standard player materials, no original Animator or game behaviours

limitations: Minimum room/movement/save loop only; original GameAssembly and game behaviours are not used.
Original build scenes require a partial geometry bridge; five builtin mesh references remain unresolved.
Player uses four selected original renderers and eleven Standard material replacements; original Animator/gameplay/appearance fidelity is not implemented.
Movement acceptance uses simulated input through the same CharacterController motor as keyboard input; hardware input was not tested.
Original shader errors and missing-script warnings remain in retained logs; callback error counts are not a claim of complete resource compatibility.
Original ES3 is read offline into a bounded seed; subsequent saves use a separate version1 JSON profile.
